description: 'This evidence-based and consensus-driven reporting guideline is being developed for systematic reviews and meta-analyses of nutritional interventions. Although almost all of the elements in the PRISMA Statement apply equally to the reporting of systematic reviews and meta-analyses of nutritional interventions, some elements might need to be adapted, tailored or extended.


  The “Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses of NUTritional interventions” is an official PRISMA development aiming at consolidating existing - and potentially new - guidance for reporting such studies. It will provide examples of good reporting for each item in the final consolidated checklist, with explanations for each adaptation or additional item.



  The project is also-registered in the Open Science Framework platform and the detailed project can be found [here](https://osf.io/b38z9/).'
